name: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
description: Scorpio's outline of the six AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism units (8 to 13), with calculus throughout. The sets are planned: their problems are not written yet.

sets.title: Charge and Coulomb's law
sets.description: Charging objects, conservation of charge and vector sums of forces between point charges.

sets.title: Electric fields of point charges
sets.description: Field vectors, field lines and superposition for arrangements of point charges.

sets.title: Fields of continuous charge
sets.description: Setting up and evaluating the integral for the field of a line, ring or arc of charge.

sets.title: Flux and Gauss's law
sets.description: Electric flux through a surface, and Gauss's law for symmetric charge distributions.

sets.title: Electric potential energy
sets.description: Energy of systems of point charges and the work to assemble or rearrange them.

sets.title: Potential of charges and distributions
sets.description: Potential of point charges by superposition and of continuous charge by integration.

sets.title: Potential and field
sets.description: Equipotentials, the field as the negative slope of potential, and potential difference as an integral of the field.

sets.title: Conservation of electric energy
sets.description: Speeds and energies of charges that move through a potential difference.

sets.title: Conductors in equilibrium
sets.description: Field, charge and potential in and on a conductor, and shielding.

sets.title: Sharing charge between conductors
sets.description: How charge redistributes when conductors touch, are connected or are grounded.

sets.title: Capacitors
sets.description: Capacitance from geometry, the field between the plates and stored energy.

sets.title: Dielectrics
sets.description: What changes when an insulator fills a capacitor, with the battery connected or removed.

sets.title: Current and simple circuits
sets.description: Current as a rate of charge flow, current density and drift speed, and reading circuit diagrams.

sets.title: Resistance, Ohm's law and power
sets.description: Resistivity, ohmic and non-ohmic elements, and the rate of energy transfer in a circuit.

sets.title: Compound circuits and Kirchhoff's rules
sets.description: Equivalent resistance, internal resistance, and loop and junction rules for multi-branch circuits.

sets.title: RC circuits
sets.description: Equivalent capacitance, and exponential charging and discharging with a time constant.

sets.title: Magnetic fields
sets.description: Properties of magnetic fields, dipoles and magnetic materials.

sets.title: Forces on moving charges
sets.description: The cross-product magnetic force, circular paths and the Hall effect.

sets.title: Wires and the Biot-Savart law
sets.description: Fields of wires and loops by integrating current elements, and forces on and between wires.

sets.title: Ampère's law
sets.description: Enclosed current and the field of long wires, thick conductors and solenoids.

sets.title: Magnetic flux and Faraday's law
sets.description: Flux through a loop, and the emf induced when that flux changes.

sets.title: Induced currents and forces
sets.description: Lenz's law, moving rods and loops, and the magnetic force on an induced current.

sets.title: Inductance and LR circuits
sets.description: Self-induced emf, energy stored in an inductor, and current that grows or decays exponentially.

sets.title: LC circuits
sets.description: Oscillating charge and current, and energy passing between capacitor and inductor.
